title: feat: add reusable onchain mint quotes
body:
## Description

This pull request adds canonical method-aware quote lifecycle support and reusable NUT-30 onchain mint quotes. It makes BOLT11 mint preparation quote-first, adds reusable onchain quote creation and balance-gated withdrawal finalization, and persists canonical mint/melt quote records across the storage adapters.

## Problem

Mint quote state was previously tied to operation-shaped snapshots, which made quote-level observation, reusable address quotes, sibling operation lookup, and adapter persistence ambiguous. NUT-30 onchain minting also needs durable NUT-20 quote keys and canonical quote balance tracking so funded reusable quotes can be claimed safely without double-spending locally executing siblings.

## Summary

- Adds `QuoteApi`, canonical quote lifecycle persistence, method-scoped mint quote data, quote-level `mint-quote:updated` events, and reusable onchain mint handling.
- Adds NUT-20 mint quote key purpose metadata plus deterministic onchain withdrawal preparation/finalization and auto-claim processing for funded reusable quotes.
- Updates SQLite3, SQLite Bun, Expo SQLite, IndexedDB, and memory repositories for canonical mint/melt quotes, legacy quote snapshot migration, and adapter contract coverage.
- Updates docs and integration coverage for quote-first minting and NUT-30 onchain mint flows.
- Compatibility risk: this changes released core APIs/events, persistent adapter schemas, and mint quote protocol behavior; changesets mark the affected packages accordingly.

## Verification

- `bun run --filter='@cashu/coco-core' test:unit`
- `./scripts/test-integration.sh sqlite-bun`

## Changeset

- Added `.changeset/quote-first-bolt11.md` for major quote-first/canonical quote storage changes across core and adapters.
- Added `.changeset/decoupled-mint-quotes.md`, `.changeset/remote-quote-fetch.md`, `.changeset/silver-onchain-claims.md`, `.changeset/smart-quote-watchers.md`, and `.changeset/bright-onchain-mints.md` for follow-up core API/event/onchain behavior updates.

title: Feat: Bolt12 payments
body:
## Description

This pull request adds BOLT12 support to coco as a first-class payment method for mint and melt operations. It integrates BOLT12 into the quote lifecycle, operation APIs, handlers, watchers, adapters, React hooks, docs, and tests while preserving coco’s method-agnostic architecture.

This pull request resolves #160 

## Problem

coco previously handled quote and operation flows around assumptions that were largely compatible with BOLT11: fixed positive quote amounts, one quote mapping to one operation, and generic quote state propagation.

BOLT12 introduces different semantics, especially reusable offers and amountless mint flows. After upstream quote handling moved into `QuoteLifecycle`, the initial BOLT12 implementation needed to be realigned so BOLT12 behavior lived in method handlers and operation services instead of leaking method-specific assumptions into generic quote lifecycle code.

## Summary

- Added BOLT12 mint and melt handlers, including BOLT12 offer support, method registration, manager wiring, and subscription support.
- Refactored shared melt behavior into a base bolt melt handler so BOLT11 and BOLT12 can share common melt logic without duplicating protocol flow.
- Updated `QuoteLifecycle` so generic quote handling can pass method data into handlers and no longer enforces BOLT11-only assumptions globally.
- Added support for BOLT12 reusable and amountless mint quotes, including explicit operation amounts when preparing from an existing reusable quote.
- Updated mint operation tracking so one reusable quote can safely map to multiple local operations.
- Updated mint watchers and processors so reusable quote updates only process operations that have individually been observed as paid.
- Added `listByQuote()` APIs for mint and melt operations to support multiple operations associated with the same quote.
- Updated React operation hooks to use structured quote lookup input and expose quote-based operation listing.
- Updated persistence schemas and repositories to support BOLT12 operation requirements and duplicate quote-id safe persistence.
- Added docs for BOLT12 minting and melting flows.
- Added unit and integration coverage for BOLT12 handlers, quote APIs, operation services, watchers, processors, and React hooks.

## Verification

- `bun run --filter='@cashu/coco-core' build`
- `bun run --filter='@cashu/coco-core' test:unit`
- `bun run --filter='@cashu/coco-core' typecheck`

Full workspace typecheck was also attempted, but it still fails on an unrelated existing sqlite resolution issue for `@cashu/cashu-ts`.

## Changeset

- Added `.changeset/bright-bolt12-offers.md`
- Marks `@cashu/coco-core` as minor and adapter/React packages as patch releases.
